title: Multiparametric Image Analysis and Correlation With Outcomes in Lung Cancer Screening and Early Stage Lung Cancer
official: Multi Parametric Image Analysis and Correlation With Outcomes in Lung Cancer Screening and Early Stage Lung Cancer
summary: Determine whether CT-based multiparametric analytical models may improve prediction of biopsy and treatment outcome in patients undergoing screening CT scan and/or treatment for early stage lung cancer
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Patients that have been diagnosed with lung cancer, and are treated at Department of Radiation Oncology, UTSW or Parkland Memorial Hospital.

Exclusion Criteria:

There will be no absolute exclusion criteria as long as the inclusion criteria have been met.
sponsor: University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center
